page.layout: One page of text, full width: woodcut frieze at top, then heading "LECTORI S." centred, then running text in paragraphs with a historiated initial H; a catchword-like marker "tanquam" at the lower right; no margin notes; a star mark "**" below the text at left.

main_text.head: LECTORI S.
main_text.p: HAbent omnes Disciplinæ suas Isagogas, & Rudimenta faciliora, quibus discentium Ingenia ad penitiorem rerum Cognitionem præparentur: Habent omnes Familiæ Nobiliores suos Janitores, & Servos Atrienses, qui Hospites excipiant, & in Palatiorum penetralia humaniter deducant: Vt habeat etiam Scripturarum explicatio suam Introductionem, & Commentatorum Nobilis Familia suos Ostiarios, & Servos Atrienses, æquum esse juxta mecum judicabis spero, Lector æquanime: Huic familiæ ut inservirem, & simul introducendis sacri Ministerii Candidatis, ad opulentiores in DEI Familia peni Procuratores, operam meam collocarem, in domus Dei limine mihi sedem elegi.

p.i: Vulgò notum est in Scholis Theologicis, quantulo tempore, quot & quanta Volumina perlegenda; quot & quæ exercitia parasceuastica adolescentibus Theologiæ studiosis absolvenda sint; & in distributione sive dierum sive horarum, ad singula studia, quantillum temporis Scripturis Divinis cedat perlustrandis, in quibus intelligendis maximè laborandum esset omnibus, præsertim verò iis qui Dominum ipsum loquentem audire vellent ut credant, & ut quæ crediderunt,

page.notes: The initial H is a decorated woodcut letter. The star mark "**" at the foot of the text is a signature-style mark, not transcribed as text. The word "tanquam" at the lower right is a catchword. The running head and page number are not printed on this page. Some letters in the italic text are worn and uncertain; no [?] was needed for the words given.
